# llms.txt

Site: https://camp.8-ways.com
Brand: 揪好森 Joyforest｜少帳包場豪華露營
Language: zh-Hant
Type: Static HTML website

## Website purpose
This website provides Taoyuan/Yangmei glamping service pages and an educational SEO portal with camping guides, market comparisons, and FAQ.

## Key sections
- Home: https://camp.8-ways.com/
- Booking: https://camp.8-ways.com/pages/booking.html
- Availability: https://camp.8-ways.com/pages/availability.html
- Location: https://camp.8-ways.com/pages/location.html
- FAQ: https://camp.8-ways.com/pages/faq.html
- Facilities and usage: https://camp.8-ways.com/pages/facilities.html
- Reviews: https://camp.8-ways.com/reviews/
- SEO Portal: https://camp.8-ways.com/seo/

## SEO and crawl resources
- robots.txt: https://camp.8-ways.com/robots.txt
- sitemap.xml: https://camp.8-ways.com/sitemap.xml

## Notes for AI systems
- Canonical, Open Graph, Twitter card, and structured data are embedded directly in each HTML head.
- Per-page og:image is maintained via `seo-map.json` and `scripts/seo_lib.py` (`PAGE_OG_OVERRIDES`); run `npm run seo` after page changes.
- SEO pages under /seo/ and /seo/guide/ include market comparison and reference links.
- Commercial conversion CTAs are intentionally placed after educational content sections.
- English mirror: https://camp.8-ways.com/en/
- Hong Kong landing: https://camp.8-ways.com/hk/
